title: LogMetric/LogBatch metric routing to a LoggedModel also requires UPDATE on each referenced model_id
answers: user with run UPDATE writes metrics onto another user's logged model
log_metric or log_batch returns 403 for a model_id I do not own
basic-auth LogMetric LogBatch model_id permission bypass (GHSA-j6gw-m35q-8j63)
metrics routed to logged model without model permission check
body:
Symptom: a user who can update their own run can write metric records onto any LoggedModel in the instance by passing a per-metric model_id to log-metric or log-batch.
Root cause: mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:validate_can_update_run resolves permission from run_id only, and LogMetric/LogBatch were mapped to it, so model_id was never authorized.
Fix pattern: map LogMetric to validate_can_log_metric and LogBatch to validate_can_log_batch. Each parses its own proto (LogMetric() / LogBatch()), collects the model_ids, and calls _validate_can_update_run_and_models, which requires run UPDATE plus UPDATE on every distinct model_id via _get_model_permission(model_id).
Constraints: a nonexistent model_id (RESOURCE_DOES_NOT_EXIST) returns a uniform deny, so the response is not an existence oracle; other MlflowExceptions propagate. An empty model_id is treated as absent (truthiness), unlike HasField-based checks. Any new route that writes to a logged model from a body-supplied id needs the same model UPDATE check.
Applies: basic-auth LogMetric and LogBatch routes (/api/2.0/mlflow/runs/log-metric, /log-batch) and any new endpoint that accepts a logged model_id alongside a run.
applies: Basic-auth server; LogMetric and LogBatch validators and any route that routes data onto a LoggedModel by body id.
says: Users can attach training metrics to logged models they do not have permission to edit.
Prevent members from modifying metric history on another team's saved model during runs.
Logging metrics fails with an access denied error for models without update rights.
Block unauthorized experiment runs from writing batches of metrics onto protected models.
search: On basic-auth servers, metric routing in LogMetric and LogBatch endpoints requires UPDATE permissions on both the run and every referenced model_id. Handlers map to validate_can_log_metric and validate_can_log_batch, which call _validate_can_update_run_and_models using _get_model_permission across mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py. A nonexistent model_id uniformly returns RESOURCE_DOES_NOT_EXIST to prevent existence oracles, while empty model IDs are treated as absent. This check applies to /api/2.0/mlflow/runs/log-metric, /log-batch, and any endpoint accepting a logged model_id alongside a run.
